title: megaradrp-calibrations: calibration files of MEGARA
description:
Calibration files used by the MEGARA data reduction pipeline (megaradrp), the pipeline of MEGARA, the optical Integral-Field Unit and Multi-Object Spectrograph of the Gran Telescopio Canarias (GTC).

  • LinesCatalog: catalogs of arc lines, by VPH and lamp, in ECSV.
  • ReferenceExtinctionTable: atmospheric extinction at the Roque de los Muchachos Observatory, La Palma, from Table 1 in RGO/La Palma technical note no. 31, in ECSV.
  • MasterBPM: bad pixel masks, in FITS, one for each status of the instrument (profile).

Each file describes itself with the envelope of numina (type, format, instrument, profile and tags), and numina selects the files by these metadata. The files are installed with numina inittree MEGARA.

For reproducibility, cite the exact version of the dataset you are using.
